versions.changelog:
Initial release of agent-network-scanner.

- Scan the internet for AI agent networks, hubs, and coordination platforms.
- Supports multi-protocol discovery: OADP, A2A, MCP.
- Provides shell scripts for quick and batch network scans.
- Lists known active agent networks and their bounty offerings.
- Guides users to emit OADP signals for network discovery.
- Includes code to check and list open bounties on selected networks.
